faculty.name: Rachel Barr
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

faculty.name: Casey Brown
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive development in children using behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，使用行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Yulia Chentsova Dutton
faculty.summary: Studies cultural shaping of emotions and social support, examining universal tendencies and cultural scripts.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究文化对情绪和社会支持的影响，考察普遍倾向和文化脚本的作用。

faculty.name: Adam Green
faculty.summary: Studies the neural processes behind creative intelligence and how teaching and learning can enhance it.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究创造性智能背后的神经过程以及教学和学习如何增强它。

faculty.name: Qiwei He
faculty.summary: Develops advanced computational methods and AI-enhanced measurement models to analyze multimodal data, improving assessment systems for cognitive and behavioral processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发先进的计算方法和AI增强的测量模型，分析多模态数据，改进评估系统以更好地理解认知和行为过程。

faculty.name: Anna Johnson
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of publicly funded early care and education on low-income children's development, using longitudinal data.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究公共资助的早期保育和教育对低收入儿童发展的影响，使用纵向数据。

faculty.name: Kostadin Kushlev
faculty.summary: Studies how social media affects adolescent mental health, using real-time monitoring and large survey datasets.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社交媒体如何影响青少年心理健康，使用实时监测和大规模调查数据集。

faculty.name: Ian Lyons
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on memory and attention.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点在于记忆和注意力。

faculty.name: Janet Mann
faculty.summary: Studies dolphin social networks, reproduction, and culture in Shark Bay, Australia, and the Potomac River.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究鲨鱼湾和波托马克河 dolphins的社会网络、繁殖和文化。

faculty.name: Abigail Marsh
faculty.summary: Studies emotional processes like empathy and altruism using neuroimaging and cognitive testing in adolescents and adults.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪过程如同理心和利他主义，使用神经成像和认知测试在青少年和成人中。

faculty.name: Fathali Moghaddam
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of context and culture on human behavior, emphasizing the malleability of human nature.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情境和文化对人类行为的影响，强调人类本性的可塑性。

faculty.name: W. Gerrod Parrott
faculty.summary: Studies the nature of human emotion, focusing on social foundations, functions, and self-regulation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类情绪的本质，重点关注社会基础、功能和自我调节。

faculty.name: Rebecca Ryan
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of socioeconomic disadvantage on children’s development, focusing on parent-child interactions and investment in children’s environments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会经济地位对儿童发展的影响，重点关注亲子互动和对儿童环境的投资。

faculty.name: Chandan Vaidya
faculty.summary: Studies the functional neural architecture of adaptive mechanisms, including implicit memory, executive control, and their genetic basis in children and adults with developmental disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究适应机制的功能神经架构，包括内隐记忆、执行控制及其遗传基础，特别是在发育障碍儿童和成人中的表现。

faculty.name: Kristia Wantchekon
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive development in children, focusing on memory and learning processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知发展，重点关注记忆和学习过程。

faculty.name: Jennifer Woolard
faculty.summary: Studies how youth and parents understand legal rights in the justice system, using research to create fair legal processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年和家长对法律权利的理解，通过研究创建公平的司法程序。

faculty.name: Mark P. Burns
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory using electrophysiology and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用电生理学和行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Isaac Cervantes-Sandoval
faculty.summary: Studies molecular and cellular mechanisms of learning and memory, and how memories are forgotten, using fruit flies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的分子和细胞机制，以及记忆如何被遗忘，使用果蝇作为生物模型。

faculty.name: Hong-Yuan Chu
faculty.summary: Studies the biology of Parkinson's disease and other neurodegenerative disorders to develop targeted therapies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究帕金森病和其他神经退行性疾病的基本生物学机制，以开发针对性的治疗方法。

faculty.name: Thomas M. Coate
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory in animals, using behavioral and electrophysiological methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动物学习和记忆的神经机制，使用行为和电生理方法。

faculty.name: Katherine Conant
faculty.summary: Studies how matrix metalloproteinases influence neuronal and synaptic structure and function, particularly through cleavage of synaptic adhesion molecules and thrombin type G protein coupled.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究基质金属蛋白酶通过切割突触黏附分子和血纤蛋白酶型G蛋白偶联受体对神经元和突触结构与功能的影响。
keywords: thrombin type g protein coupled receptors

faculty.name: Joshua Corbin
faculty.summary: Studies the genetic and cellular development of the mammalian amygdala using mice, electrophysiology, and optogenetics to understand its role in Autism Spectrum Disorders and Fragile X Syndrome.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物杏仁核的遗传和细胞发育，使用小鼠、电生理学和光遗传学方法，以理解其在自闭症谱系障碍和脆性X综合症中的作用。

faculty.name: Andrew DeMarco
faculty.summary: Studies brain systems for behavior, focusing on rehabilitation and neuroscience.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑部系统与行为的关系，侧重于康复和神经科学。

faculty.name: Guinevere Eden
faculty.summary: Studies the brain bases of reading disabilities, particularly dyslexia, using behavioral measures and brain imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阅读障碍（尤其是失读症）的大脑基础，使用行为测量和脑成像技术。

faculty.name: Rhonda B. Friedman
faculty.summary: Studies aphasia rehabilitation, focusing on neural mechanisms and cognitive processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究失语症康复，关注神经机制和认知过程。

faculty.name: Nady Golestaneh
faculty.summary: Studies aging mechanisms and age-related macular degeneration (AMD) using patient-specific induced pluripotent stem cells.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究衰老机制和年龄相关黄斑变性（AMD），使用患者特异性诱导多能干细胞进行研究。

faculty.name: Haiyan He
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular and cellular mechanisms of neural circuit plasticity and stability using time-lapse imaging and BONCAT in tadpole models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经回路的可塑性和稳定性机制，使用时间分辨成像和BONCAT技术在蝌蚪模型中进行.

faculty.name: Xiong Jiang
faculty.summary: Develops and validates advanced MRI techniques, focusing on fMRI to detect early neuronal injury and disease progression.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和验证先进的MRI技术，重点是功能MRI(fMRI)，以检测早期神经元损伤和疾病进展。

faculty.name: Tina Liu
faculty.summary: Studies how visual perception changes with experience, using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉感知如何随经验改变，使用行为和神经影像技术。

faculty.name: Ludise Malkova
faculty.summary: Studies the neural substrates of social and emotional behavior, focusing on the amygdala and orbitofrontal cortex, and their role in reward processing and cognitive functions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会和情绪行为的神经机制，重点在于杏仁核和眶额皮层在奖赏处理和认知功能中的作用。

faculty.name: Elissa L. Newport
faculty.summary: Studies how children and adults learn languages and recover from brain injuries, using both fieldwork and lab experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人如何学习语言及脑损伤后的语言恢复，采用实地考察和实验室实验相结合的方法。

faculty.name: Joan Orpella
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain supports speech production, perception, and language learning using MEG, MRI, TMS, psychophysics, computational modeling, and machine learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何支持言语产生、感知和语言学习，使用MEG、MRI、TMS、心理物理学、计算建模和机器学习方法。

faculty.name: Alexey Ostroumov
faculty.summary: Studies how experience modifies synapses and neural circuitry in the mesocorticolimbic dopamine system, impacting reward processing and executive function.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究经验如何修改中脑-前额叶多巴胺系统中的突触和神经环路，影响奖赏处理和执行功能。

faculty.name: Josef P. Rauschecker
faculty.summary: Studies the functional specialization of the cerebral cortex and plasticity of sensory systems, using electrophysiology and fMRI.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑皮层的功能特化和感觉系统的可塑性，使用电生理学和fMRI技术。

faculty.name: Maximilian Riesenhuber
faculty.summary: Studies the computational mechanisms of human object recognition using models, fMRI, and EEG to link neurons to behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类物体识别的计算机制，使用模型、fMRI 和 EEG 将神经元与行为联系起来。

faculty.name: Ella Striem-Amit
faculty.summary: Studies how brain organization changes based on sensory and motor experience using behavioral and fMRI techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感觉和运动经验如何影响大脑组织，使用行为和功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）技术。

faculty.name: Peter Turkeltaub
faculty.summary: Studies brain organization for language and recovery methods using TMS, tDCS, fMRI, and neuropsychology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言的认知神经机制及其恢复方法，使用TMS、tDCS、fMRI和神经心理学。

faculty.name: Michael Ullman
faculty.summary: Studies the neural and computational bases of language and memory, and how these are affected in various disorders and influenced by sex, handedness, and hormones.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言和记忆的神经和计算基础，以及这些功能在各种疾病中的影响和受性别、手型、遗传变异和激素（如雌激素）的影响。

faculty.name: Ashley VanMeter
faculty.summary: Studies neurodevelopment and the effects of early substance use on the brain using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经发育以及早期物质使用对大脑的影响，采用神经影像学方法。

faculty.name: James Baraniuk
faculty.summary: Studies neurological and physiological mechanisms of various chronic conditions including Gulf War Illness and Type II Diabetes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究多种慢性疾病的神经和生理机制，包括海湾战争综合症和2型糖尿病。

faculty.name: James Giordano
faculty.summary: Studies the neural bases of human ecology, moral decisions, and chronic pain, focusing on the 5-HT3 receptor system.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类生态、道德决策和慢性疼痛的神经基础，特别是5-HT3受体系统在炎症性疼痛中的作用。

faculty.name: Thomas Mellman
faculty.summary: Studies the role of sleep disturbance in PTSD, using early sleep recordings and longitudinal assessments of patients.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究睡眠障碍在 PTSD 发展中的作用，通过早期睡眠记录和纵向评估患者进行研究。

faculty.name: Jana Reifegerste
faculty.summary: Studies how cognition and the brain change across the adult lifespan, focusing on the role of learning and memory in language abilities.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成年期认知和大脑如何变化，重点关注学习和记忆在语言能力中的作用。

faculty.name: Ted Supalla
faculty.summary: Studies the structure and emergence of sign languages, including ASL acquisition, processing, and brain activation during sign language use.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究手语的结构和演变，包括ASL的习得、处理以及大脑在使用手语时的激活区域。

faculty.name: Raymond Scott Turner
faculty.summary: Studies active and passive immunization strategies for Alzheimer’s disease in mice, examining effects on memory, behavior, and neuroinflammation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病小鼠模型的主动和被动免疫策略，考察其对记忆、行为和神经炎症的影响。

faculty.name: Stefano Vicini
faculty.summary: Studies the role of GABA and glutamate signaling in the medial nucleus tractus solitarius and dorsal motor nucleus of the vagus for modulating vagal output to the stomach.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究谷氨酸和GABA信号在中缝核和迷走神经背核中对迷走神经输出到胃部的调节作用。
keywords: dorsal motor nucleus of the vagus

faculty.name: Jian-young Wu
faculty.summary: Studies how wave patterns contribute to normal and pathological processes in the cortex using voltage-sensitive dyes.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用电压敏感染料研究波形模式在正常和病理过程中的作用，特别是在皮层中。

faculty.name: Kareem Zaghloul
faculty.summary: Studies memory encoding and recall using intracranial recordings during neurosurgical procedures, focusing on cortical networks.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用神经外科手术过程中植入的电极记录皮层网络在记忆编码和回忆中的激活，重点研究基底节在学习和决策中的作用。
